evidence.testTitle: matrix media persistence r2 MEDIA-001 MEDIA-002 MEDIA-003 MEDIA-006 MEDIA-013 MEDIA-014 private ownership and deletion persist
evidence.scenarioScope: Miniflare R2 and SQLite durable-object persistence with actual public REST and IRC; no deployment, IAM, signed-link or delivery-feature claim.
evidence.rationale: Executed provider-specific lifecycle assertions with independently inspected persistent state.
assertionDetails: Owner and unrelated account upload; anonymous upload denied; unrelated deletion denied; owner deletion removes R2 object and SQLite row while unrelated bytes remain.
After dispose and restart with persistent R2 and SQLite, fresh password logins verify deleted URL including legacy query variants stays 404, unrelated bytes survive, and wrong owner is denied.
Actual SQLite rows and bucket objects inspected independently; upload/delete have no IRC event contract and no media identifiers or bytes appear on connected IRC streams.

evidence.testTitle: matrix media persistence r2 MEDIA-004 MEDIA-005 MEDIA-008 MEDIA-010 MEDIA-011 channel and DM scopes protect bytes and headers
evidence.scenarioScope: Miniflare R2 and SQLite durable-object persistence with actual public REST and IRC; no deployment, IAM, signed-link or delivery-feature claim.
evidence.rationale: Executed provider-specific lifecycle assertions with independently inspected persistent state.
assertionDetails: Private #private and public #public plus Alice/Bob DM created through authenticated REST and IRC; third principal denied secret and DM bytes and private response metadata, including forged query identity.
HTML filename, attachment disposition, CSP sandbox, nosniff and private no-store checked; exact bytes and MIME metadata independently read from R2 and scopes and filename from SQLite.
PART revokes Bob private-channel access before and after complete recreation, while Alice and DM participant Bob retain access; public channel remains accessible to authenticated Charlie.
IRC PRIVMSG live-control reaches private member Bob and not Charlie; upload IDs and bytes do not appear on monitored streams, with no claimed upload event contract.

evidence.testTitle: matrix media persistence r2 MEDIA-009 MEDIA-012 ABUSE-007 enforces byte limit and cumulative quota without harming another owner
evidence.scenarioScope: Miniflare R2 and SQLite durable-object persistence with actual public REST and IRC; no deployment, IAM, signed-link or delivery-feature claim.
evidence.rationale: Executed provider-specific lifecycle assertions with independently inspected persistent state.
assertionDetails: 10 MiB plus one byte rejected; ten 10 MiB R2 uploads reach 100 MiB owner quota and another byte is denied; deletion permits replacement while Bob upload survives.
SQLite owner totals and R2 object counts checked independently, then runtime recreated and fresh logins confirm quota persists, deleted object remains absent and unrelated Bob bytes persist.

events.rationale: Upload size and quota controls have no public event contract; no event delivery is claimed.
